anselm.name: Anselm Ring
anselm.dependency: The Beanstalk, its tether to Earth at Macapá, and the trade that comes up it.
anselm.grievance: That the other stations resent it.

belvedere.name: Belvedere
belvedere.dependency: Hosting capacity that it buys, and the price of it.
belvedere.grievance: Proposals to change the legal status of its residents' running copies, whose earnings make up much of its income.

meridian.name: Meridian Spindle
meridian.dependency: The Clothesline's traffic rights, which it does not own.
meridian.grievance: That Anselm Ring sets the schedule.

corvus.name: Rookworks—Anselm
corvus.dependency: Berth allocation at the Anselm locks.
corvus.grievance: That it comes second to Anselm Ring in every federal allocation, beginning with berths at the Anselm locks.

sable.name: Bondsville
sable.dependency: The Bond, which is leased rather than owned.
sable.grievance: The lease terms on the Bond, which were signed when the station was smaller.

halvard.name: Halvard Works
halvard.dependency: The rent on the volume it lets to other stations' businesses.
halvard.grievance: Every proposal to tax volume by position, of which there have been six.

bourse.name: The Bourse
bourse.dependency: Continuous access to every other station's figures.
bourse.grievance: Attempts to place underwriting under statutory oversight.

winter_garden.name: The Winter Garden
winter_garden.description: The capital, and the only habitat in the Commonwealth built as a single continuous garden: a river running from the cold end to the warm, a hill at the centre, forest and meadow on the flanks, and the congress hall where the Charter was signed standing in the middle of it. The Earth states keep their legations sealed along the river, little pieces of their own worlds dropped into the biome, and the walk between them passes six climates in a mile.
winter_garden.grievance: That its seat, the Capital Territory, has a member and no vote in the House.

hollows.name: Brant—Ellery—Kincaid
hollows.grievance: That Brant, Ellery and Kincaid were joined into one station and one seat without being asked.

tsiolkovsky.name: Farstead
tsiolkovsky.grievance: That substrate rents are set by the providers on the ring band.

coldharbour.name: Coldwater
coldharbour.dependency: It is a substrate farm. It depends on the price of what it sells.
coldharbour.grievance: That its own residents pay the full market rate for the substrate the station produces.

erasmus.name: The Rotunda
erasmus.grievance: That the licensing boards it staffs are appointed by ministers it did not elect.

nasmyth.name: Hammerstead
nasmyth.dependency: It builds radiators. It depends on the appropriation that funds them.
nasmyth.grievance: That its own radiator array has had eight years of deferred maintenance.

vantage.name: Ember Ridge
vantage.dependency: Radiator capacity. Below statutory reserve since 6 April.
vantage.grievance: That the radiator fault which put it below its statutory reserve on 6 April has not been repaired.

perigee.name: Fore River Yards
perigee.grievance: That recent yard contracts were awarded elsewhere.

calloway.name: Calloway Loop
calloway.grievance: That its place in the shed order is tier three and has been falling.

grimaldi.name: Layover
grimaldi.dependency: Traffic, because the station is a junction.
grimaldi.grievance: That traffic schedules through the junction are set by stations that do not pass through it.

wickstead.name: Harvest
wickstead.grievance: Imported consumables undercutting its own decks.

oberth.name: Bethesda
oberth.grievance: That it is blamed for waiting lists for treatment, which federal licensing sets.

tannery.name: The Tannery
tannery.dependency: It processes what other stations will not.
tannery.grievance: That its work is classed as essential while its people are in tier four of the shed order.

ashfield.name: Homestead
ashfield.dependency: Federal consumables lift, three deliveries weekly. Fourteen days of stored margin.
ashfield.grievance: That it has been in tier four of the shed order for eleven consecutive years.

kepler.name: Anchorage
kepler.dependency: The International Earth-Orbit Elevator, whose anchor stands on Kenyan soil.
kepler.grievance: That the lifeline is in another state's jurisdiction.

slagworks.name: Hardie
slagworks.dependency: Feedstock contracts and the consumables lift.
slagworks.grievance: Essential-services legislation, which its unions read as a muzzle.

bellows.name: Sunman
bellows.dependency: It runs an atmosphere plant serving four stations. It depends on power.
bellows.grievance: That it is paid an ordinary contractor's rate for the atmosphere plant on which four stations depend.

cinder.name: Lantern
cinder.grievance: Its place in the shed order, and the smell of the refining it does for other stations.

tallow.name: Pavilion
tallow.grievance: That its workers process the Commonwealth's food and cannot afford the volume they live in.

quarry.name: Stanbridge
quarry.dependency: Construction demand, which is set by the volume appropriation.
quarry.grievance: That its work rises and falls with the volume appropriation, which it has no say in.

drift.name: The Verge
drift.dependency: Federal transfers, for almost everything it consumes.
drift.grievance: Its place in the shed order and the size of the federal consumables lift.

sinter.name: Colonnade
sinter.grievance: That the yards whose orders it depends on are three bands away and deal with it by contract alone.

dredge.name: John Henry
dredge.dependency: Debris salvage contracts and the Kessler appropriation.
dredge.grievance: That debris salvage is dangerous and necessary work, and is paid as scavenging.

bloomery.name: The Bloomery
bloomery.grievance: That it is legislated for by a chamber none of whose members have visited.

l4.name: Leadside
l4.grievance: Federal oversight of a station that funds itself.

achenar.name: Outermost
achenar.dependency: It reports no dependency on the Commonwealth.
achenar.grievance: That it is counted in the apportionment at all: it regards its membership of the federation as a courtesy.

l5.name: Sanctuary
l5.dependency: It reports no dependency on the Commonwealth.
l5.grievance: That the Commonwealth legislates for it at all.

log.text: The House rises for the recess, and returns on 2080-05-23 for the second sitting period of the session.
The House rises without supply. The government cannot pay for itself.

The Reserve Bank held the cash rate at 4.50 per cent.

The draft estimates
Who holds the Treasury — Appoint Aster Skye, the Financial Secretary, who knows the estimates line by line.

log.text: The first question — A government that is not the last one. This party has changed, and I changed it.
Adriana Eireann Flash — The Edge of History — Nothing specific. Tell him the government intends to last its full term, and that he will learn of its decisions when they are announced.
